text_md: Sincerely, Abiola Idowu Receivables Analyst- (Sponsored Students) Abiola.idowu@umanitoba.ca 204-474-8718 9th January 2018 Sponsorship application received after the deadline of 9th January 2018, will result in an assessment of $50 late payment penalty to your Student account and further $40 late fee will be applied at the end of revision period if the Sponsorship application is not received. If payment has not been made by the due date, you and your sponsor will be notified by email that payment has not been received. Following which your student account will be placed on hold and access to administrative services will be suspended and future term registration will not be permitted until the overdue balance has been paid in full.
